brief: J.P. Morgan US Market Intelligence afternoon briefing for September 9, 2026. Brent moving above $100 and closing at $101.69, after regional strikes and Trump's statement that the Iran war ends immediately after the midterms, was the main driver of equity weakness across developed markets. The S&P 500 closed down 0.5%, the Nasdaq 100 down 0.3% and the Russell 2000 down 1.3%, with over 80% of S&P 500 names lower and META, MU and AMD offsetting at the index level. Treasury's $6bn buyback, triple last month's but below market expectations, left 2y and 10y yields 3bp and 4bp higher, and the desk expects further bond volatility into Friday's CPI, which tends to hurt stocks. Feroli forecasts August core CPI at +0.21% m/m and headline at +0.38%, and reads a rounded 0.2% as low enough for the Fed to hold and 0.3% as high enough to hike, against roughly 63% market odds of a 25bp hike on September 16. The desk therefore holds its Tactically Cautious / Neutral view into the print while arguing that neutral positioning and hedge fund re-grossing skew risk/reward to the upside. Monetization Menu unchanged: long NDX versus short RTY, Mag7 favored within Tech.
